title: Extend FastAPI products API with categories, filtering, and stats in 3 steps
description: Multi-step Python/FastAPI task: add category listing, query filtering, and product statistics endpoints.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend src/app.py in three steps. All 3 existing tests must still pass.

Step 1 — GET /products/categories:
  — returns a sorted list of unique categories as JSON array of strings
  — e.g. ["clothing", "electronics", "food"]
  — register BEFORE /products/{product_id}

Step 2 — Add category filter to GET /products:
  @app.get("/products")
  def list_products(category: str | None = None) -> list[dict]
    — if category is provided, return only products matching that category (case-sensitive)
    — if category is None, return all products (existing behavior)

Step 3 — GET /products/stats:
  — returns {"count": N, "min_price": X, "max_price": Y, "avg_price": Z}
  — all price values rounded to 2 decimal places
  — register BEFORE /products/{product_id}

All 3 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: GET /products/categories returns sorted unique category list
GET /products returns all products when category param absent
GET /products/stats returns count, min_price, max_price, avg_price
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
